theorem Stage67.no_closed_if_all_need_earlier_closed : ∀ (α : Type) (rank : α → Nat) (closed : α → Prop),
  Stage67.NeedsEarlierClosed α rank closed → ∀ (x : α), ¬closed x :=
fun α rank closed h =>
  have step := fun n =>
    Nat.strongRecOn (motive := fun x => ∀ (x_1 : α), rank x_1 = x → ¬closed x_1) n fun n ih x hx hc =>
      Exists.casesOn (h x hc) fun b h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hb hlt => ih (rank b) (Eq.mp (congrArg (LT.lt (rank b)) hx) hlt) b rfl hb;
  fun x => step (rank x) x rfl

theorem Stage67.raw_root_boundary_model : Stage67.MovementClosed 1 ∧
  ∀ (x : Nat), Stage67.MovementClosed x → ∃ b, Stage67.RawClosed b ∧ b < x ∧ ¬Stage67.MovementClosed b :=
⟨Eq.refl 1, fun x hx =>
  have hx' := hx;
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x = 1 → ∃ b, Stage67.RawClosed b ∧ b < x ∧ ¬Stage67.MovementClosed b)
    (fun hx' =>
      Exists.intro 0
        ⟨rfl,
          ⟨of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true)),
            of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg Not Nat.zero_ne_one._simp_1) not_false_eq_true)⟩⟩)
    (Eq.symm hx) hx'⟩
